verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show Outlook letting a user ask an assistant questions across the whole inbox and calendar and get grounded answers. The Graph API mailbox search and people suggestions are developer building blocks, not the assistant itself. A community user querying mail through a third-party LLM/MCP integration is a user-side workaround. One community post mentions a 'Copilot integration' in Outlook but says nothing about cross-inbox or calendar Q&A or grounded answers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers
